notes.title: Dreamout Joins Sword Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/4a4229099f716a648d6a712707f23c8d6fb68cd4.jpg[/img]

Hello!
From September 1st to 8th, 2025, [b]Dreamout[/b] is taking part in [b]Sword Celebration[/b] — a special Steam festival dedicated to games featuring swords.

Dreamout is a wild journey through twisted realities, where a drunken alpaca wielding a sword cuts down enemies without giving them a single chance. Humor, absurdity, and steel blend into a unique experience that perfectly fits the spirit of Sword Celebration.

Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the upcoming full release and special rewards for participating in the playtests!

[h2]ABOUT THE PLAYTESTS[/h2]
[h3]Remember, the playtest will include two Steam achievements. One of them — for completing the game in a time challenge — grants a reward: a game key for one of the other titles from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Game%20Dynasty]Game Dynasty[/url].[/h3]

[u]The playtest start date will definitely be announced in advance.[/u]

[h2]INFORMATION FROM THE PUBLISHER[/h2]

Discover new worlds, fresh ideas, and unique atmospheres in other games, each of which reveals the power of the sword and the spirit of adventure in its own way.

[b]Test yourself in a hardcore RPG with a non-linear story and survival elements.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

[b]You are not a hero. You are a contractor managing a mercenary guild with sword and calculation. Try the demo and immerse yourself in a world where morality has a price, and survival is everything. Playtest sign-ups are open![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180000/Blades_For_Hire/

[b]Immerse yourself in turn-based strategy with RPG elements in the spirit of Heroes of Might and Magic. Demo available now.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779310/Stones_Keeper_II_Chaos_Lord/

[b]Hardcore battles in the spirit of Dark Souls, a variety of deadly swords and weapons, a dark atmosphere, and challenges worthy of true warriors.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

notes.title: Tiny Teams 2025: Sign Up for the Dreamout Playtest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/ca800f29ef0a35c3c8409c38ff9dec78a880489c.jpg[/img]
Dreamout is taking part in Tiny Teams 2025 — this week the game is featured on a special Steam event page dedicated to the best indie projects from small development teams.

To mark the occasion, sign-ups for the upcoming playtest are now open. This will be a limited version of Dreamout, giving selected players early access to the game before its full release.

[h3]The playtest includes two Steam achievements. One of them — for completing the game in a time challenge — unlocks a special reward: a game key for one of the other titles from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Game%20Dynasty]Game Dynasty[/url].[/h3]

To sign up, click “Request Access” on the game’s Steam page.
You’ll receive a notification once the playtest begins.

notes.title: 🌟 Dreamout is joining INDIE3!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/4a3aae76e41f8ea36eb3b5a74c40cdea83f5f287.jpg[/img]

[b]Dreamout[/b] is part of [b]INDIE3[/b], the big summer showcase of top indie titles, curated by Clemmy's Best Indie Games! Very soon, you'll see Dreamout featured among a handpicked selection of games aiming to win players' hearts around the world.

[b]INDIE3[/b] is a week-long celebration of indie games, filled with exclusive reveals, updates, and a dedicated Steam event page for all participating titles.

[h2]Dreamout Playtests Begin July 1st![/h2]
We're excited to announce that starting today, you can sign up for the [b]playtests[/b]!

Subscribe now to get early access and dive into the atmospheric world of Dreamout.

👉 Click "Request Access" on the Steam page to join the playtest!

notes.title: The update for the demo version is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/e9b7327a2f33ccb045fef6e6ec81cc72777caf6d.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, friends![/h3]

The development of the game is progressing as planned, and to make sure you don’t get bored, I decided to update the demo version so it better reflects what I plan to showcase at the final release.

New features have been added, the gameplay has been improved, and minor issues have been addressed. But let’s dive into the details:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to customize controls. 
[*] Localization added for the following languages: Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, and Japanese.
[*] Joy and anger animations have been added for all characters.
[*] New enemies – Bandits. 
[*] Added markers to help navigate the game world.
[*] Destructible objects have appeared in the game world, dropping coins upon destruction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/42a95323334c633dccca4b1df40973866f6189f6.gif[/img]
[*] 3 new skins are now available for purchase using coins.
[*] A huge number of various bugs have been fixed. 
[*] Significant work on SFX: all missing sounds and ambient effects have been added, while old sounds have been improved and balanced for volume.
[*] Introduced the Magic Cards mechanic – create one of four items to solve puzzles.
[*] The alpaca is still drunk.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/4de6f68a50c86e4f41cb311647abe3d9f31dc382.gif[/img]

Jump in, test it out, and enjoy the updated version!🎮✨

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820100/DREAMOUT/
